meta.description: Explore Phnom Penh Night Market in Cambodia. Find opening hours, location, food, shopping, transportation and travel information.

hero.title: Phnom Penh Night Market
hero.subtitle: Set along the Tonle Sap riverfront, the Phnom Penh Night Market is a lively evening gathering place where locals and visitors browse stalls, enjoy street food, and experience the city's nightlife.

intro.title: About Phnom Penh Night Market
body: The Phnom Penh Night Market (Khmer: ផ្សាររាត្រី ភ្នំពេញ) is an open-air evening market located on the riverfront along Preah Sisowath Quay, near the junction with Street 106 in central Phnom Penh, Cambodia.
Every evening as the sun sets, vendors set up stalls selling clothing, accessories, handicrafts, and souvenirs, while a large food section offers grilled dishes, noodles, and drinks beside the river.
More than a shopping spot, the market reflects everyday urban life in Cambodia's capital — a relaxed place where residents wind down and visitors get a feel for local culture after dark.

culture.title: History & Culture
body: Night markets are a long-standing part of urban life across Cambodia and Southeast Asia. In Phnom Penh, evening markets grew as the city's riverfront became a focal point for public life after sunset.
The riverside night market is part of a broader revival of Sisowath Quay, where the open promenade by the Tonle Sap river draws crowds for evening walks, food, and socializing.
Today the market is woven into the weekly rhythm of the city: a casual, family-friendly space shaped by local commerce rather than formal tourism.

shopping.title: Shopping Experience
shopping.intro: Stroll through rows of stalls offering a mix of local and regional goods.

items.title: Traditional Crafts
items.desc: Handmade textiles, silk scarves, and Cambodian handicrafts from local makers.

items.title: Souvenirs
items.desc: Postcards, magnets, and small keepsakes to remember your trip.

items.title: Clothing & Accessories
items.desc: T-shirts, beachwear, bags, and affordable everyday fashion.

items.title: Local Products
items.desc: Snacks, spices, and everyday items favored by local shoppers.

food.title: Food & Drinks
food.intro: A dedicated food area lets you sample Cambodian street food by the river.

items.title: Cambodian BBQ
items.desc: Grilled meats and skewers cooked over charcoal at busy stalls.

items.title: Noodles & Soups
items.desc: Warm bowls of kuy teav (rice noodle soup) and other Cambodian staples.

items.title: Spring Rolls
items.desc: Fresh and fried rolls served with dipping sauce.

items.title: Fried Rice
items.desc: Simple, filling plates of fried rice with vegetables and egg.

items.title: Fruit & Drinks
items.desc: Fresh tropical fruit, juices, and iced shakes to cool off.

items.title: Around 17:00
items.desc: Stalls begin to open and the temperature eases after the afternoon heat.
Best atmosphere with full lighting, more vendors, and lively crowds.

items.title: Avoid Midday
items.desc: The market is an evening event; visiting at noon means little is open.

transport.title: How To Get There
transport.intro: The market sits on the central riverfront, within reach of most downtown areas.

modes.title: On Foot
modes.desc: Easy to reach on foot if you are staying near Sisowath Quay or the riverside.

modes.title: Tuk Tuk
modes.desc: A common, flexible way to get around Phnom Penh; agree on the fare first.

modes.title: Taxi / App
modes.desc: Ride-hailing apps operate in the city for a more comfortable trip.

modes.title: Public Transport
modes.desc: Local buses serve central Phnom Penh, though routes are limited at night.

items.title: Sisowath Quay Riverside
items.desc: A riverside promenade for evening walks, city views, and open-air dining along the Tonle Sap.

items.title: Royal Palace Area
items.desc: Cambodia's royal compound and nearby temples showcase classic Khmer architecture.

items.title: Central Phnom Penh
items.desc: Explore the city center, including markets and streets close to the riverfront.

items.title: Bring Small Cash
items.desc: Stalls mostly take cash; keep small notes handy for easier payment.

items.title: Bargain Politely
items.desc: Haggling is normal at markets — keep it friendly and good-natured.

items.title: Watch Your Belongings
items.desc: Crowded markets call for basic care with bags and phones.

items.title: Ask Before Photos
items.desc: A quick smile and gesture goes a long way when photographing people.

items.q: What time does Phnom Penh Night Market open?
items.a: The market generally begins to open around 17:00 each evening.

items.q: Is Phnom Penh Night Market free to enter?
items.a: Yes, entering the market area is usually free; you pay only for what you buy or eat.

items.q: What can visitors buy at the night market?
items.a: Visitors can find souvenirs, clothing, handicrafts, and a range of local goods.

items.q: Is the night market suitable for tourists?
items.a: Yes, it is a relaxed, family-friendly place to experience Phnom Penh's nightlife and market culture.
